scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A convincing identity claim
scenes.caption: Asha receives a synthetic interview message from a cloned-looking profile and hears a familiar voice. The caller claims institutional authority and asks her to keep the conversation secret while using a new verification number.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Identity can be manufactured
scenes.caption: A profile image, realistic voice or video and a formal title can be copied or manipulated. Two channels supplied by the same claimant are not independent. These observations call for verification rather than proving who created the message.
scenes.dialogue: Familiar appearance is not independent authority.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Triangulate outside the channel
scenes.caption: End the pressured interaction and use a previously known careers-office route and an independently supplied organisation contact. Compare the exact role and request, protect personal data and record what remains unknown. An unanswered check is not confirmation.
scenes.dialogue: Independence matters more than the number of screens.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the verification protocol
scenes.caption: Should Asha use the caller’s new number, send an identity scan as a test, or use known independent contacts and keep the request paused until it is supported?
scenes.dialogue: A test disclosure is still a disclosure.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A bounded identity result
scenes.caption: One supplied office check confirms an advertised role, but the claimant’s identity and private payment request remain unresolved. Asha updates only the role-existence claim and retains the pause on documents and money.
scenes.dialogue: Confirming one fact does not verify the entire interaction.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the identity lab
scenes.caption: Separate identity signals from authority, build independent checks and handle partial confirmation. The simulation creates no real voice clone or call, and it never asks for an actual identity document.
scenes.dialogue: Verify the exact person, channel and requested action.
